properties.markdownProperty:
A **Use case** for each identified use case, with its description, precondition, normal sequence, postcondition and exceptions. The level of detail must be decided according to the importance of each use case.
The normal sequence is made up of steps (children of the use case): **Actor-system step**, **System step**, **Actor-actor step** and **Use case action step** (which performs another use case), with an optional condition, and **Conditional branches** that group several steps. Each step can have **Exceptions**, with one or more actions. Use cases that are only performed within others are specified with the **Abstract use case** archetype.
